function fillOrder(uint256 id, uint256 amountAToFill) external nonReentrant { Order storage o = orders[id]; require(o.active, "inactive order"); require(amountAToFill > 0 && amountAToFill <= o.amountA, "invalid fill amount"); uint256 amountB = (amountAToFill * o.priceB1e6 + 1e6 - 1) / 1e6; uint256 fee = FEE_BPS == 0 ? 0 : (amountB * FEE_BPS + 9999) / 10000; uint256 net = amountB - fee; address maker = o.maker; o.amountA -= amountAToFill; if (o.amountA == 0) o.active = false; _call(address(tokenB), abi.encodeCall(IERC20.transferFrom, (msg.sender, maker, net))); if (fee > 0) _call(address(tokenB), abi.encodeCall(IERC20.transferFrom, (msg.sender, feeCollector, fee))); _call(address(tokenA), abi.encodeCall(IERC20.transfer, (msg.sender, amountAToFill))); emit OrderFilled(id, msg.sender, amountAToFill, amountB); }
